title: 二維半導體轉移與接觸
summary: 從單層與晶粒、轉移殘留到晶圓可製造性：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Monolayer and grains and Transfer residue to Wafer manufacturability: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 單層與晶粒 → 暫時載板
stages.titleEn: Monolayer and grains to Temporary carrier
stages.description: 把「單層與晶粒」「成長與轉移」「暫時載板」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Monolayer and grains, Growth and transfer, Temporary carrier.

steps.title: 單層與晶粒：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Monolayer and grains: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects.
steps.instruction: 畫單層厚度、晶粒邊界與覆蓋率，分開三種品質指標。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Separate monolayer thickness, grain boundaries and coverage in a sketch. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷；晶粒取向也會改變接合邊界。
steps.observationEn: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects; Grain orientation changes boundary character.
steps.failure: 若採用「全片覆蓋便視為所有載子路徑相同」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating full coverage as identical transport everywhere", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「單層與晶粒」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Monolayer and grains diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects.

steps.title: 單層與晶粒：故障判讀與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Monolayer and grains artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Treating full coverage as identical transport everywhere". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Grain orientation changes boundary character. If total resistance at one spacing is 5 kΩ, the model assigns 3 kΩ to the channel. This decomposition assumes contact/channel consistency and does not apply to arbitrary nonlinear injection curves.
